sections.heading: Description
lines: Pale Garden is a custom field effect that does not appear in Pokémon Rejuvenation. It is based on the Pale Garden biome of Minecraft and is found in the Pale Garden biome.
The field follows the rules of Bewitched Woods and adds the Creaking Distraction: a counter for each side that closes in on whichever side keeps attacking.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Fairy-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x, deal super-effective damage to Steel-types, and deal neutral damage to Dark-types.
Grass-type moves increase in base power by 1.5x.
Dark-type moves increase in base power by 1.3x and deal neutral damage to Fairy-types.
Poison-type moves deal neutral damage to Grass-types.
Grounded Grass-types restore 1/16 of their max HP each turn.
Sleeping Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 of their max HP each turn.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Effect Spore's activation rate is doubled to 60%.
Flower Gift is always activated.
Flower Veil now affects all Pokémon regardless of their typing.
Mimicry changes the bearer's type to Fairy.
Natural Cure additionally heals status at the end of the turn.
Pastel Veil additionally negates the bearer's Fairy-type weaknesses.
Power Spot raises the power of the partner's moves by 1.5x.
Prankster can now affect Dark-types.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Hex, Mystical Fire, Spirit Break → 1.5x boost.
Aurora Beam, Bubble Beam, Charge Beam, Flash Cannon, Hyper Beam, Ice Beam, Magical Leaf, Psybeam, Signal Beam → 1.4x boost.
Dark Pulse, Moonblast, Night Daze → 1.2x boost.
Other moves:
Forest's Curse additionally Curses the target.
Grass Whistle, Poison Powder, Sleep Powder and Stun Spore's accuracy is increased to 85%.
Magic Powder additionally inflicts Sleep on the target.
Moonlight heals 75% of the user's max HP.
Strength Sap additionally lowers the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Field-dependent moves:
Camouflage changes the user's type to Fairy.
Nature Power becomes Dazzling Gleam.
Secret Power may inflict Sleep, Poison, or Paralysis.
Shelter halves damage from Fairy-type moves.
Terrain Pulse's type becomes Fairy.

sections.heading: Creaking Distraction
lines: Each side has its own counter, from 0 to 3.
A damaging move that connects adds 1 to its side's counter, at most once per side per turn. This also applies in Double Battles.
A status move that succeeds resets its side's counter to 0. Using one does not give back that turn's damaging tick.
When a side's counter reaches 3, every active Pokémon on that side loses 40% of its max HP, even through Protect or a Substitute, and the counter returns to 0.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost if it changes the field, unless noted otherwise.
This field will transform into Forest Field if the move Purify is used.
“The evil spirits have been exorcised!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Magical Seed raises the holder's Defense by 6 stages and petrifies it.
